changeSet.author: local-chinese-edition
changeSet.comment: PostgreSQL's legacy organization short-name default is the literal value "". Normalize only the China bootstrap records so facility selectors render 本院 instead of "" - 本院.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.organization SET short_name = NULL, lastupdated = now() WHERE code IN ('CN-LOCAL', 'CN-OPD', 'CN-ED', 'CN-IPD', 'CN-PE') AND short_name = '""';
